body.statement: If \(\mathrm{oeq:global\text{-}endpoint\text{-}response}\) is resolved affirmatively, the raw error is bounded by \(\mathfrak R_{H,n}\). At the selected resolutions, \(\sqrt{\ell_n/(n_\ast h_n^d)}=h_n^s\), \(k_n^s[1+\log(1/k_n)]\le Ch_n^s/\ell_n\), and \(\ell_n/[n_\ast(h_nk_n)^{d/2}]+\eta_n^2=o(h_n^s)\) because \(2r<s\). Hence constants \(C_0,C_1,n_0\), depending only on \(d,s,R,m,M,b,B,L\), satisfy, for every \(n_\ast\ge n_0\), \(\mathfrak R_{H,n}\le r_{H,n}=C_1h_n^s\le m/2\) and \[\inf_{\mathbf P\in\mathcal M_s}\mathbb P_{\mathbf P}(\mathcal B_n)\ge1-\delta.\] On \(\mathcal B_n\), Weyl's inequality gives \(\widetilde H_p(u)\succeq(m-r_{H,n})I_d\succeq(m/2)I_d\); hence \(\widehat H_p=\Pi_{m/4}(\widetilde H_p)=\widetilde H_p\) simultaneously, and \[\max_{p\ne q}\lvert\widehat\gamma_{pq}-\gamma_{pq}\rvert\le w_n.\] Consequently, the everywhere-defined \(\Psi_n\) has size at most \(\delta\) over \(\gamma_{pq}\le0\) and power at least \(1-\delta\) over \(\gamma_{pq}\ge3w_n\).
body.justification: The theorem makes the two-resolution rate auditable, proves clipping is inactive on the coverage event, and propagates the unmodified population Hessians to a strict causal certificate.
body.gap: ManoleBalakrishnanNilesWeedWasserman2023CLT proves pointwise map central limit theorems on a flat torus and failure of global weak convergence, while existing multivariate-rank results do not cover Hessians or an infimum eigenvalue margin.
body.consumer: Applied users of multivariate transport counterfactuals can certify a margin separated from zero with controlled familywise error across regimes.
